name: falsify_c1_expects_no_candidate
description: FALSIFICATION of the 'no candidate' judgement. Identical to c1_hopstep_pre_then_post except that clip 1 expects no candidate. The run is the normal one, so it must exit 1 with exactly [candidate_unexpected] on clip 1: the candidate that is really there must not be missed. Exit 1 alone is not the pass condition; another code, or exit 2, means the judgement was not tested.
